text: {"assertions":["A crash loop in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml was reproduced by rolling out to the small node pool.","The crash loop manifested as containers restarting seconds after start.","Only clients using the v1 SDK were affected by the crash loop.","The root cause was the serializer dropping unknown fields.","The fix switched to a strict schema rejecting unknown fields, implemented in PR #1228 on branch fix/crash-loop-1.","After the fix, throughput increased by 58 percent to reach 56 requests per second.","The Kubernetes deployment stack uses YAML with manifest lint and dry-run CI checks for coverage."]}
